description: This file defines a React component 'InfiniteCalendar' which implements an infinite scrolling calendar view with dynamic month insertion and navigation controls.

methods.name: goToMonth
methods.description: Scrolls the calendar to the specified month, inserting it if necessary.

methods.name: resetNumberOfCalendarsToBase
methods.description: Resets the months list to only include the specified date centered.

methods.name: toggleVisibility
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of the calendar view.

methods.name: elementIdForMonth
methods.description: Generates a DOM element ID for a given month based on year and month.

methods.name: handleDaySelection
methods.description: Handles user selecting a day, updating months and invoking callback.
